purpose: Regenerated restoration assets for approved FireDesmoke research film
illustrations: Existing calibrated-field transfer and paired-training illustrations retained; these are not model predictions.
continuous_fire: Original private H264 frames 840–1019 at 30 fps, independently restored without interpolation. Playback is not inference speed.
fire_stills: CAND_020_40 and CAND_058_50 use November 13 deidentified release inputs; the HazeFlow comparison uses its rerun output on that release.
models: SmokeBench uses FireDesmoke* (320/80); other restoration uses full FireDesmoke (384/96). Both use horizontal flip averaging.
